description: PROP-307e -- a real, spec'd, tier-1/required:true proof obligation (verification-architecture.md:520, 'run.sh's own PRODUCTION body genuinely calls decideColonySpawn()... and, only if eligible:true, calls executeSpawnAttempt()... new, sprint-2 contract-review round 2, resolves FIND-004') that contracts/sprint-2.md's own CRIT-201 passThreshold (line 25, 'per REQ-307's own "wake-cycle scheduler's real identity" correction... run.sh... MUST be rewritten this sprint to call decideColonySpawn() then... executeSpawnAttempt()'), CRIT-205's passThreshold (line 45, explicitly citing 'PROP-307e's own run.sh wiring' as one of the named call sites to verify), and the 'Deferred-obligation disposition' section (line 171, '...PLUS the new PROP-307e (run.sh's real wake-cycle wiring, resolves FIND-004)') all explicitly require this sprint to target/verify/close -- has NO corresponding entry anywhere in state.json's `proofObligations` array. Independently checked this session: PROP-307a/b/c/d each have a real state.json entry (PROP-115/116/117/118, each `artifact: 'specs/verification-architecture.md#PROP-307a|b|c|d'`); PROP-204d/PROP-307f (the two obligations FIND-010/round-6 added) each have a real entry too (PROP-119/PROP-120); but a search of all 120 entries in state.json's `proofObligations` array for any entry whose `artifact` field references 'PROP-307e' returns ZERO matches -- the id sequence jumps directly from PROP-118 (artifact #PROP-307d) to PROP-119 (artifact #PROP-204d) to PROP-120 (artifact #PROP-307f), with no id ever assigned to #PROP-307e. Consequence: even though the underlying CODE genuinely implements this behavior correctly (run.sh execs scripts/wake-gate.mjs, which calls decideColonySpawn then executeSpawnAttempt -- independently re-confirmed structurally correct by rounds 3/4/5's own prior reviews), there is no state.json bookkeeping entry that Phase 5/vcsdd-harden's own 'all required obligations proved' gate could ever promote to status:'proved' for PROP-307e specifically -- the obligation the contract itself names as a required sprint deliverable is untrackable. This also explains an internal counting inconsistency in the SAME 'Deferred-obligation disposition' section that round-8's own verdict noticed but declined to file (citing narrow same-round-only scope): the section's literal enumeration lists exactly 25 Tier>0 + 5 Tier-0 PROP IDs (=30), then separately appends 'PLUS the new PROP-307e' as a 31st item -- implying 31 total obligations targeted -- while CRIT-205's own text (line 43-45) says 'the 30 targeted PROP IDs (including PROP-307e)', implying PROP-307e is one of the 30, not additional to it. Both readings cannot be simultaneously true (25+5+1=31 != 30-including-the-+1=30); the root cause is that PROP-307e was apparently always intended to receive its own state.json tracking id (like its siblings PROP-307a-d/204d/307f all did) but this step was never actually done, leaving the count description ambiguous because the obligation itself was never concretely instantiated.
